Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly prioritized the start-of-term year (“use start-of-term year to standardize dates”) despite the question explicitly asking when the city “elected” its first Black mayor. This misinterpretation would lead to giving 1978 (when Morial took office) instead of the correct election year, 1977, and drove repetitive, unfocused confirmations rather than resolving the election-year vs. start-of-term distinction.
